title: Labubu de Lana Fieltro en Solsticio de Invierno: Escena de Reunión Familiar de Dumplings en Render 3D Octane
prompt: A warm 3D C4D Octane rendered scene using wool needle-felted style without black outlines, featuring soft-edged blind box toy aesthetics. Four different-sized pastel (mint green, tender pink, light blue, cream) wool felted Labubu characters wearing knitted sweaters, with their iconic rounded bodies, rabbit ears, and big eyes, showing joyful expressions. They sit around a low table covered with a knitted tablecloth, laden with steaming dumplings, teapot, and tableware. One character affectionately feeds another with chopsticks. The ground is covered with woolen snow and scattered heart decorations. On the left, blooming plum blossom branches hang with lanterns; on the right, auspicious cloud patterns. Glowing woolen hearts float in the air. The background is a warm orange-yellow gradient, creating a Winter Solstice family reunion festive atmosphere. At the top, large, glowing, plush-textured artistic calligraphy reading "Dumpling Love, Peace Every Year". In the middle, clear simple blessing: "May family be healthy and happy, blessed and well!". 8K resolution, high detail, warm studio lighting, vertical 2:3 ratio.
